book.title: Matiyu Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Matiyuyaŋ meluwaŋ mge

content: Imbi nemba 10 ekŋengalen bemzenze zet
Kan keyet Kawawaŋgalen zemâtâtâtgat katnanen mama ke imbi nembip 10 ekŋenaŋ taŋamin timti an ŋenaŋ imbi wawagalen kopme selen aiikgalen mebien ke sepem sokbewe.
Ekŋenmagengatnaŋ imbi nemba 5 ekŋen nânâŋinpiŋ ma 5 ekŋen nânâŋinmak.
Nânâŋinpiŋ ekŋenaŋ taŋamin mbienaŋgut tuŋaŋ butnaŋ ŋamgat ku mbien.
Âpme nânâŋinmak ekŋenaŋ seŋgewinan taŋam tuŋaŋ kasime topme taŋaminmak ilinsakwep mmebien.
An imbi wawagalen egaŋ sakwep ku kopme imbi nembip ekŋenaŋ damuŋ tabienaŋ melupgat sukŋaŋ bemti meluk wembien.
Tawene peme tambu sutnan temaŋ kwizet pigok koge, ‘An imbi wawagalen kozin! In wati toaigit!’
Kegok kume nâmti imbi nembip ekŋenaŋ ilindiŋ wati taŋamin weyaŋbien.
Kegok mti nânâŋinpiŋ ekŋenaŋ nânâŋinmak ekŋengat zewien, ‘In nin taŋam tuŋaŋ bugan kasim ndait. Ningalen taŋamlak bep zein.’
Zeme nânâŋinmak ekŋenaŋ gilik zemti zewien, ‘Inmak ninmak nsakwep tuŋaŋ bugan kapiyaŋ ŋep ku bendesemgat in dalaŋ mkaen met ilinaŋgat kwitim kolit.’

Kegok zemindeme imbi nembip nânâŋinpiŋ ekŋenaŋ tuŋaŋ kwitisât mebien. Ekŋenaŋ met mame mame an imbi wawagalenaŋ pataŋ peye. Âpme imbi nembip 5 damuŋ tabien ekŋenaŋ ekmak awembiŋ bembeyelen tu meuyet ondedak mkaen mowepme sekekek kege.
Kegok sokbeme bamgat imbi nembip nânâŋinpiŋ ekŋenaŋ pataŋ zemti zewien, ‘Amobotnaŋ, amobotnaŋ, nâmndemane kwatne!’
An imbi wawagalenaŋ zeye, ‘Neŋ penaŋ diindowi, neŋ in kandat indeyap.’
Zisasiyaŋ zet kegok zemdelaŋ zemti kapigok zeye, in kan kwilekiyet ma bet kwilekiyet ma tambuŋan ma gasiyet kobe ke ku nâip keyepmti in kelem mbep.
Mulup nemba mânep indandaŋaŋgalen bemzenze zet
Maneti amobotnaŋ ŋenaŋ msat pemŋen mesât mti egaŋ mulup nembaŋane kume kopme kwilekikiŋaŋ sambe belinan bemti ekdamuŋ mimiyet zemindeye.
Egaŋ mulup nemba kwep kwep ekŋengat sepemin ma windeŋin nâmti keyet kataŋ mânep indaye. Kwep ŋen 5000 kina saye. Ŋen 2000 kina saye. Ŋen 1000 kina saye. Kegok indamâti egaŋ msat sukwep mege.
Egaŋ mepme mepme mulup nemba 5000 kina tiye egaŋ sakwep penaŋ mânep keyaŋ mulupmaŋ mmepme 5000 kina ŋen ewe mânep tâgâŋaŋ aige.
Sepem kegogak mulup nemba mânep 2000 kina tiye egaŋ mulupmaŋ mmepme 2000 kina ŋen ewe mânep tâgâŋaŋ aige.
Âpme mulup nemba mânep 1000 kina tiye egaŋ mobotnaŋaŋgalen mânep ke msat walati keŋan kwatampeye.
Kan teepmaŋ penaŋ delaŋ zeme bamgat mulup nemba ekŋengat amobotnaŋinaŋ gilik zem koge. Koti mânep indaye keyelen yaŋaŋ nâsât ondek indeye.
Mulup nemba 5000 kina tiye egaŋ 5000 kina tâgâŋaŋ aikge ke mkoti zeye, ‘Amobotnaŋ ekbak, geŋ 5000 kina nawananaŋ neŋ mulupmaŋ sama 5000 kina tâgâŋaŋ aikban.’

Amobotnaŋaŋ zeye, ‘Geŋ mulup nemba pembenaŋ penaŋ. Geŋ zetn gawepumti mulup pembenaŋ penaŋ mbanan. Geŋ mânep isikŋaŋ ŋep mandamuŋ mnikgapmti neŋ mânep temaŋgat damuŋ mimiyelen gewap. Geŋ neŋmak kopmane oloŋen mdi.’
Mulup nemba 2000 kina tiye egaŋ kogak koti zeye, ‘Amobotnaŋ, geŋ 2000 kina nawanan. Ekbak, neŋ mulupmaŋ sama 2000 kina tâgâŋaŋ aikban.’

Amobotnaŋaŋaŋ pigok dunduye, ‘Geŋ mulup nemba pembenaŋ penaŋ. Geŋ zetn gawepumti mulup weyaŋti mbanan. Geŋ mânep isikŋaŋ ekdamuŋ ŋep mbanan keyepmti neŋ mânep temaŋgat damuŋ mimiyelen gewap. Keyet geŋ neŋmak kopmane oloŋen mdi.’

Âpme mulup nemba 1000 kina tiye egaŋ koti zeye, ‘Amobotnaŋ, neŋ nâyap ke geŋ an katikŋaŋ. Geŋ mânep tuŋgupmaŋ nembandineyaŋ monze onze mulup mti onzenzeŋanengatnaŋ timti tosayet bemane kopme matinik ma geŋ mânep setnaŋ mtitiyelen omba nâmtatnik.
Kegok nâmti neŋ mânep tima mebegat kiŋgati met 1000 kina ke msat keŋan atam pema matazin keyepmti ekbak, kapi gitaŋgalen mânep ikŋaŋ ke gilik zem gayap.’

Zeme amobotnaŋaŋ gilik zemti zeye, ‘Geŋ mulup an bekanaŋ ma awisatoŋ! Geŋ nânak, neŋ mânep tuŋgupmaŋ nembanneyaŋ monze onze mulup mti onzenzeŋanengatnaŋ timti tosayet bema kopme matiap ma neŋ mânep setnaŋ mtitiyelen omba nâmtalap.
Nâmane kegok beme geŋ nâlen mânepm mânep mkaŋan bewekwan ya neŋ gilik ze kobagen nenaŋgalen mânep ilindiŋ timti tâgâŋaŋ notnaŋ tiwak.’
Amobotnaŋ kegok zemti gilik zemti an mulup an ŋengat zeye, ‘Mânep ke menzem mti an 10,000 kina tasain ke sait.’

Amobotnaŋ keyaŋ tusumti zeye, ‘An ŋenaŋ kwileki notnaŋ tasame keyet mulupmaŋ mam beme kwileki notnaŋ ewe tusumti same ekmagen polak polak wemsawe. Âk am ŋenaŋ kwileki ŋen isikŋaŋ tasame mulupmaŋ ku mbe beme ewe kwileki isikŋaŋ penaŋ bugan tasain ke kogogak menzempewep.
Keyepmti mulup nemba bekanaŋ ke putatime zupman tambusosok keŋan ke mamti si zemsu zemsu mti zetnaŋ aŋgalikti mamambe.’
Zisasiyaŋ koti am kalaŋsâpm
Maneti Angat Nemuŋaŋ neŋ winde temaŋmak enselne indatetimti kosowap. Koti damuŋ mulup mimiyelen Amobotnaŋgalen munduman totasowap.
Âpme am sambe msat ŋen msat ŋen keyet keŋangatnaŋ am ilindiŋ mamkandaŋnan ondek indesowap. Sekam sipsip damuŋaŋ sipsipmak meme makalaŋidein sepem kogak mbap.
Mti neŋ am teŋ maip ekŋen betn penaset zemindema tabep naman am notnaŋ betn alomeset zemindema tabep.

Maŋge bemindemti Amobotnaŋ neŋ am betn penaset pigok diindowap, ‘In Bienmak tusum talip keyepm kolit. Kawawaŋgalen zemâtâtâtgat katnanen mama keŋan mamayelen eweŋan msat sokbeme baenen ke weyaŋpepeŋaŋgat koti mama kanzizit tit.
Ke pigogat neŋ meuyet mma in meu nambien. Neŋ tuyet tapmma in tu name nimban. Neŋ an mamanam kopma in notn mnemti mkaŋinan natetimobien.
Neŋ melakandunduyet olapma in melakandu nawien. Neŋ zawat mma in nikdamuŋ mbien. Neŋ mka katikŋan tapma in met nikdamuŋ mti mukulem mnembien. Keyepmti in kolit.’
Zema am teŋ bembeŋaŋaŋ pigok gilik zesâbip, ‘Amobotnaŋ, nin kan kwilekiyet geŋ gikmann meuyet tapmmane meu gawenn ma tuyet tapmmane tu gawenn?
Ma geŋ denen an mamanamaŋ kopmane nin weyaŋgewenn ma melakandunduyet olapmane melakandu gawenn?
Ma kan kwilekiyet zawalen ma mka katikŋan wemane nin mukulem mgewenn?’

Âpme Amobotnaŋ neŋ zet dopmaŋ pigok gilik zewap, ‘Neŋ penaŋ zema nâit, in kan ke ma keyet nâlen notn an tototnaŋ nâmkiŋpepemak mukulem mpewien in ke ek etaŋ ku mukulem mpewien. Ke neŋ mukulem mnewienok bein.’

Mti neŋ betn alomset tabep ekŋengat pigok zewap, ‘In nenemti sebeit! In teziŋ ŋandayet zapat ombemindendeŋaŋ. Teziŋ taŋamaŋ delaŋ zenzeŋepiŋ ke Sadaŋ ma enselŋane ekŋengat weyaŋpepeŋaŋ keyet keŋan towelip!
Ke pigogat neŋ meuyet mma in meu ku nawien. Neŋ tuyet mma in tu ku nawien.
Neŋ an mamanam kopma in neŋ notn mnemti mkaen ku newien. Neŋ melakandunduyet olapma in neŋ melakandu ku nawien. Neŋ zawalen ma mka katikŋan tapma in ku namukulem mnewien.’

Zema ekŋenaŋ pigok gilik zem zewep, ‘Amobotnaŋ, nin denen gikmann meuyet mmane ma tuyet mmane ma an mamanam kopmane ma melakandunduyet olapmane ma zawalen wemane ma mka katikŋan tapmane nin ku mukulem mgewenn?’

Âpme Amobotnaŋ neŋ dopmaŋ pigok gilik zem indawap. ‘Neŋ penaŋ sukwep diindowi, in kan ke ma keyet nâlen notnne peweweŋaŋ ekŋenmagengatnaŋ ŋen mukulem ku mpewien beme in neŋ ku mukulem mnewienok bein.’
Kokgapmti zemindema ekŋenaŋ yomgalen dopmaŋ gakiki delaŋ zenzepiŋ keŋanen towebep. Âpme am teŋ Kawawaŋgat zet kandaŋan maiwaŋ mama kanzizit tiwep.”
